title: Adding evidence in log-odds form
description: You can follow three likelihood ratios into one posterior probability.

steps.description: update_log_odds adds the log likelihood ratio to the current log odds. You return the updated value without changing representation.
The prior probability is 0.1. You convert it to log odds and prepare log ratios for 3, 0.5 and 2.

steps.question: Does the loop apply each ratio to the original prior or the accumulated value?
steps.answer: It uses the accumulated lg_post, so each piece of evidence builds on the preceding update.

steps.description: You convert the final log odds back to probability. The supplied output prints Posterior probability: 0.25.
